scope: Source API inspection. These revisions are not a claim about the packages installed on the test handset.

sources.finding: QStateAction has valid/state but no enabled. AyatanaMenuAction has valid/enabled/state and activate/changeState; service disappearance unregisters the native action muxer.
UT brightness uses the power indicator action brightness in [0,1]. The stock settings page blocks manual slider input while com.lomiri.touch.system auto-brightness is enabled.
wifi.enable, airplane.enabled and mobiledata.enabled toggle through parameterless activate. Their enabled state is owned by the service.
bluetooth-enabled takes a Boolean activate parameter; bluetooth-supported identifies hardware support.

volume change-state accepts a normalized double and uses native volume clamping. The service observes headphone multimedia volume, opens its native warning and lowers volume at the threshold; only the native confirmation approves/restores high volume. volume-sync changes when warning state changes. silent-mode activates with Boolean.
rotation-lock is a Boolean stateful action bound to the display indicator GSettings key. The phone menu activates it with a Boolean parameter.
Native persistent-message widgets retain swipe-dismiss and inline reply; BaseMenu exposes backColor/color, foregroundColor and menuStyle.

host_requirements: Load the native component only in an unlocked non-greeter phone session.
Set actionsAllowed only while the panel is fully open and no native modal notification blocks input.
Do not synthesize persistent notification history from Lomiri.Notifications ephemeral popup model.
Respect indicator valid/enabled state, and cancel local volume gesture state when volume-sync changes.
Installed package versions and QML file hashes still require device-side verification.

native_validation.result: 11 scenarios passed with actual Qt 5 QMenuModel native plugin and GSimpleActionGroup services on a private DBus
limits: Indicator services simulated; no handset runtime result
High-volume policy implementation source-inspected; warning/sync messages simulated
reproduction: Use an isolated Python environment with PyQt5 and a host that provides libgio-2.0.so.0, libgobject-2.0.so.0 and dbus-run-session.
Download the exact native_packages URLs above, verify their SHA-256, and extract both with dpkg-deb -x <file.deb> <temporary-runtime>. No system package install is needed.
Prepend <temporary-runtime>/usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu and the PyQt5/Qt5/lib directory to LD_LIBRARY_PATH, then run python tests/test_native_backend.py. The test itself creates a private DBus session.
A sandbox must permit the private local Unix socket. No network or device access is performed during the test.
native_validation.bug_found_and_fixed: Raw JS clamp endpoints 0 and 1 became int32 GVariants, rejected by native double-state actions. The request is now passed through a typed qreal property; the real native test verifies both endpoints and fractional values.
